title: Pointwise L² bound from the ball mean value identity (Cauchy–Schwarz)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, y ∈ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n), ρ > 0, and let f : ℝⁿ → ℝ be continuous on closedBall(y, ρ). Put V := Lⁿ(B̆_ρ(y)) as a real number, i.e. (volume (ball y ρ)).toReal. If f satisfies the ball mean value identity ∫_{B̆_ρ(y)} f = V·f(y), then f(y)²·V ≤ ∫_{B̆_ρ(y)} f².
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Euclid n → ℝ) (y : Euclid n) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ContinuousOn f (closedBall y ρ) → ∫ z in ball y ρ, f z = (volume (ball y ρ)).toReal * f y → f y ^ 2 * (volume (ball y ρ)).toReal ≤ ∫ z in ball y ρ, f z ^ 2
